name: Minnesota

office.name: MnDOT Office of Freight & Commercial Vehicle Operations - Oversize/Overweight Permit Section

fees.note: §169.86 subd. 5(a): $15 per single trip permit (valid 7 days).

Overweight single trip = $15 base + damage assessment fee: miles x sum of per-mile cost factors for each over-legal axle group (2-axle group $0.12-$0.30/mi, 3-axle $0.05-$0.19/mi, 4-axle $0.04-$0.20/mi by group weight). Needs axle-group weights, so not computed here.

restrictions.text: Over 12'6" wide (or over 110' long): no travel statewide from 2:00 pm the day before a holiday to 2:00 am the day after (MnDOT holiday schedule); Memorial Day-Labor Day no travel Fridays and Sundays 4:00-8:00 pm.
Over 110' long: holiday ban 2:00 pm day before to 2:00 am day after; summer Fri/Sun 4:00-8:00 pm ban; no travel weekdays 6:00-8:30 am and 3:30-6:00 pm in Twin Cities and Duluth metro.
Over 14'6" wide: no travel weekdays 6:00-8:30 am and 3:30-6:00 pm in the Twin Cities and Duluth metro areas unless the permit says otherwise.
Over 16' wide: in the Twin Cities seven-county metro, travel only 12:00-5:00 am Monday-Friday unless the permit says otherwise.
Otherwise travel is generally not time-restricted. No movement in hazardous weather/road conditions or when visibility is under 500 ft.

travel.holidays: No travel from noon the day before through the holiday; a Monday or Friday holiday closes the long weekend

notes: Peace officer escort (plus lead and rear escorts) is required whenever any part of the load or vehicle extends left of the centerline on an undivided roadway (§169.812 subd. 2(d)) - depends on lane width, not modeled. MnDOT may add escorts on the permit.
Width escort trigger is > 15 ft measured at the bottom of the load OR > 16 ft measured at the top; calculator uses overall width vs 15 ft.
Escort drivers must hold Minnesota pilot-car certification (or CO, FL, NC, OK, UT, VA, WA certificates).
No published 'superload' class found; heavy loads go through MnDOT route/bridge approval on the permit. Verify any extra review thresholds with MnDOT.
Legal overall length 75' is the general rule; TT + semitrailer longer than 75' is allowed only on 4-lane divided highways and designated access routes.
MnDOT permits are valid on Interstate, US and MN state highways only; county/township/municipal roads need local approval.
